title: Textures better
description: The texture pack improves the game's quality to version 1.21.11
body: **Hey there! :)** time to show off my texture pack for Better Minecraft. This pack is a total overhaul and makes every aspect of the game better! First up I designed my own version of the hud to make it cleaner and easier to understand. Trash that cluttered little screen, and say hello to a sleek-looking interface with easy-to-see blocks, names, and health bars. No more straining your eyes for that tiny number! :( The next thing I focused on was mitigating unnecessary visual noise. Because nobody wants the games they love to be screaming at them for attention! The world looks smoother, ores pop more easily, and thanks to a happier mind your eyes will be in less pain at the end of your long mining process. And your tools, the food, and even your blocks all got a huge upgrade with a shine in my textures. Thanks to the fantastic new animation added to the sword in my textures we can now enjoy a swift animated glow whenever you fight that big boss for ultimate bragging rights! The true fun of my textures is how well they keep the same old vanilla spirit while removing all the ugly distractions. Whether you're raiding an ancient temple or just hanging around your castle castles, Better Minecraft is just plain better with my textures on! Come give it a go, and tell me what you think! :)
